channel.title: Notice Board weekly: Skamania County
channel.description: Once a week: what is open for comment and coming up for a decision in Skamania County. Not an official notice.

item.title: Skamania County notices, week of November 2: 2 open for comment, 5 meetings coming up
item.description:
What is open for comment and coming up in Skamania County, from the notices printed in the county papers and the agencies' own postings. Dates are as printed. This is a guide, not the official notice: each link opens the card, which links the notice itself.

Open for comment

  • Comments close Wednesday, November 11 · Stevenson City Council
    Determination of nonsignificance: Backwoods Brewing Company industrial wastewater discharge (new)
  • Comments close Tuesday, November 17 · WA Department of Ecology
    Public Hearings and comment period on state shoreline rules

Hearings and meetings, through Tuesday, November 17

  • Tuesday, November 3, 5:00 pm · Skamania County Commissioners
    Public hearing to consider adoption of the 2027 Preliminary Budget (new)
  • Tuesday, November 3, 7:00 pm · North Bonneville City Council
    Upcoming study sessions (new)
  • Wednesday, November 4 · Skamania County Mosquito Control District
    Public Budget Hearing (new)
  • Monday, November 9, 6:00 pm · Stevenson City Council
    Public hearing during the Planning Commission meeting on the state-required periodic update to the Critical Areas Ordinance (new)
  • Tuesday, November 10, 7:00 pm · North Bonneville City Council
    Second public hearing to review the 2027 City budget (new)

Bids, contracts and board seats

  • Bids due Friday, November 13 · Mill A School District #31
    Seeking responses from contractors interested in conducting a Slash Pile Abatement via Mastication Project (new)
  • Bids due Thursday, November 19 · Stevenson City Council
    RFQ for on-call engineering services
  • Bids due Thursday, November 19 · Stevenson City Council
    RFQ for on-call SCADA, controls & operational support services
  • Bids due Thursday, November 19 · Skamania County Commissioners
    Countywide Bridge Scour Project: seeking qualifications from consulting firms (new)

Elections

  • Election day, Tuesday, November 3 · Skamania and Klickitat county auditors
    Ballot measures, November 3, 2026 General Election
  • Election day, Tuesday, November 3 · Skamania County Auditor
    General Election, November 3, 2026

On the horizon

  • Not scheduled yet · Skamania County Commissioners
    A hearing on the county's data-center moratorium

See the whole Notice Board, or pick your town there to see only what applies where you live.
